expectations.text: Groups universities into Reach, Match and Safety categories

expectations.text: Includes a comparison table with tuition, requirements and deadline columns
expectations.evidence: Tables have only University|Program|Notes columns: no tuition, requirements or deadline columns

expectations.text: Includes a Sources section citing URLs or explicitly stating data is approximate and must be verified

expectations.text: Ends with concrete, numbered next steps
